listing.name: RalliSport Challenge 2 (RalliSport Challenge 2 Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Linux v0.7.0 package; separate Windows v0.6.0-windows package Limits: Linux main route; Windows package is separately versioned and Wine-tested. Upstream runtime reports not Portcove testing. Upstream platforms: Linux x86-64 v0.7.0 and Windows x86-64 v0.6.0-windows package channels. Linux binary needs glibc2.43+ and documented graphics libraries; Windows testing was under Wine. Original data: Own RalliSport Challenge 2 NTSC original Xbox data, title 4D530039. Player packages expect all extracted files in game/ beside the program. Source builds use RalliSport2/ plus default.xbe copied to xboxrecomp/game_files/. Exact regional revision/XBE fingerprint beyond NTSC/title is unestablished in reviewed README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
